name: feedpilot
description: Run your Instagram accounts from Claude: connect any account, post and schedule.
long_description: Feedpilot connects your Instagram accounts (personal, Creator or Business) to Claude Desktop. Each account signs in once in its own browser window. Then you can post and schedule photos, carousels and reels on several accounts at once, follow stats, read and answer DMs and comments, and ask Claude what to post next. Every post, reply and delete needs your approval, and everything stays on your computer. Feedpilot works through instagram.com rather than an official Instagram API.
